_comment: Katalogmetadata for dette treet. Feltene country, institution, division, subjectFamily, subjectArea og language lagrer NØKLER fra ../vocabulary.json, ikke ferdig tekst — teksten slås opp der, på leserens språk. En nøkkel som ikke finnes der er en feil og stopper treet i katalogen.
title: Mathematics 2P (decomposition demo)
subtitle: Practical mathematics, Vg2 general studies
summary: What the decomposition prompt returns in a single run, before a teacher has revised anything: the first draft for Mathematics 2P from one conversation with a language model that had no web access and was given the seven competence aims, published unedited so that the method can be judged on what it actually produces. The Norwegian tree for the same subject is the revised one to compare it against.
author: Vidar Skogvoll
